name: Randy

scaling.scaled: 55/35 lb keeping sets of 10+, or 50 reps at 75/55. When form degrades to a stiff-legged pull, the load is wrong regardless of what the clock says.
scaling.beginner: 50 dumbbell snatches (alternating arms) at a light weight. The power snatch pattern first, the volume later.

origin.summary: Honors Los Angeles Police Department SWAT Officer Randy Simmons, 51, killed in the line of duty on February 7, 2008 — the first LAPD SWAT officer to die in the unit's history. Seventy-five power snatches at 75 lb: light, fast, and a masterclass in how a 'light' barbell stops being light.

description: 75 power snatches for time at one fixed barbell weight — a single-movement, high-volume sprint similar in spirit to Isabel but at much higher volume and a lighter load.
source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08
